verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own docs list unattended access with a permanent password, which is the core of this story. However, Wayland unattended access and login-screen access are documented only in a separate x86_64 Debian/Ubuntu preview build, which is a real platform limitation. A community user also welcomed the Wayland unattended-access fix, implying it was previously broken. missing for 10: documentation of how admins pre-configure or deploy the permanent password ahead of time (e.g., mass deployment or centralized settings tied to unattended access), general-release Wayland and login-screen unattended support, and independent hands-on confirmation of unattended setup.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set up unattended access to a machine with credentials configured in advance, so no one has to sit at the host to accept

citations.quote: unattended access with a permanent password
a separate x86_64 Debian/Ubuntu-based preview adds Wayland unattended access and login-screen access.
